page_title: NAP 0-0 LEC | Napoli v Lecce 26/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Wladimiro Falcone into a superb diving save to keep it out.
90+4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

90+3' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' 67:33 – the ratio of ball possession.
87' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

87' A neat pass is well received by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
85' It is time for a substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) is on for Giovanni Di Lorenzo.
84' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) meets a cross inside the box, but Wladimiro Falcone wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

83' Remi Oudin (Lecce) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
81' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
80' Federico Dionisi blows the whistle, Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is penalised for a foul.
79' A lofted cross from Hamza Rafia (Lecce) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
78' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
77' Luca Gotti has decided to substitute Medon Berisha and he is replaced by Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
77' The referee signals a substitution. Remi Oudin (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Alexis Blin.
77' Leo Ostigard (Napoli) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
76' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lecce was in an offside position.
74' Medon Berisha (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
73' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Federico Dionisi saw the whole situation.

71' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Wladimiro Falcone, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
71' The game is interrupted. Victor Osimhen (Napoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
69' A pass from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.
65' Francesco Calzona has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Victor Osimhen (Napoli) replacing Jens Cajuste.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) will replace Antonino Gallo.
64' Leo Ostigard (Napoli) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
62' Federico Dionisi blows for a foul after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
60' Medon Berisha (Lecce) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
59' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 17:4.
57' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
56' Luca Gotti prepares a substitution. Pontus Almqvist is replaced by Joan Gonzalez (Lecce).
55' Here's the change. Nikola Krstovic leaves the pitch and Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) comes on as a substitute.

55' CHANCE! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
53' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!

52' Good chance! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
52' A pass into the box finds Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the top left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Wladimiro Falcone denies him.
50' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
50' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

49' That was a nice football moment. Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Wladimiro Falcone guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
49' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
48' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) attempts to release Pontus Almqvist with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
46' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' The game is over for Giovanni Simeone. Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Francesco Calzona probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Matteo Politano (Napoli). He is replaced by Cyril Ngonge.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45' Federico Dionisi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
42' Medon Berisha (Lecce) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
40' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
39' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Federico Dionisi stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
38' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
37' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli).
34' Juan Jesus (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
31' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 63:37.
28' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
27' The resulting corner from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
26' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
23' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

20' That's a well-taken pass by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
18' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
18' Alexis Blin (Lecce) commits a rough foul. Federico Dionisi stops the game and makes a call. Napoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
17' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
16' Alexis Blin (Lecce) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Napoli get a free kick.
15' Federico Dionisi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) and blew his whistle.

11' Fine attempt! Matteo Politano (Napoli) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
11' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

9' OFF THE POST! Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
7' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Federico Dionisi blows for a foul.
4' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Federico Dionisi.
